description: Attach an existing organization channel to an agent, so the channel's events wake it. Find the channel with list_channels. A webhook channel lets callers outside Valet reach the agent. Attaching a channel that is already attached reports it and changes nothing. Slack needs a Slack app and a browser, so for Slack this gives the step to take and attaches nothing. Requires connecting a Valet account.

channel.description: Required. The organization channel's name, from list_channels.

org_name.description: The Valet organization both belong to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: attach_channel
title: Attach a channel
